mapper.select: select U_ID as uId,SYS_Position.P_ID as pId,D_ID as dId from SYS_Position_User left join SYS_Position on SYS_Position.P_ID=SYS_Position_User.P_ID where SYS_Position.D_ID in( select D_ID from SYS_Position where P_ID in(select P_ID from SYS_Position_User where U_ID=#{uId}))

select U_ID as uId,SYS_Position.P_ID as pId,D_ID as dId from SYS_Position_User left join SYS_Position on SYS_Position.P_ID=SYS_Position_User.P_ID where SYS_Position.D_ID in
#{dId}
select D_ID from SYS_Position where P_ID in(select P_ID from SYS_Position_User where U_ID=#{uId})

select U_ID,P_Name,uIds,D_ID from SYS_Position_User pu left join SYS_Position p on p.P_ID=pu.P_ID left join (select D_ID as did,U_ID as uIds from SYS_Position_User ppu left join SYS_Position pp on pp.P_ID=ppu.P_ID )t1 on p.D_ID=t1.did where #{params.dname} like concat('%',p.P_Name,'%') and uIds in ('${params.userid}')
